speak.title: Role-play: a day off for launch day
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: Your employee wants Friday off. The team is busy this week. Ask at least two questions before you decide. You can say yes, no, or yes with a condition.

b.text: A game you've waited years for comes out on Friday. Ask for the day off. Explain why it matters to you and how your work will be covered.

phrases: I was hoping to take Friday off.
It's something I've waited years for.
I'd be happy to say yes if you finish the report first.
I'm afraid that's not possible, because we're short of staff.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: did the manager say yes, and was it a fair decision?
